style: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE equipment inventory icon for a cute creature-collecting game. A square PNG with genuine transparent background. Match this collection's Anchor Charm: very thick near-black plum-brown outer contour, chunky rounded proportions, broad clean color areas, simple hard-edged cel shading, one broad highlight and one shadow, no surface texture. Design for final 256x256 pixels and tiny 13x13 to 64x64 display. Bold unmistakable silhouette and generous negative spaces, 3-5 main colors maximum. Center whole item on a square canvas, filling 85-90% of its area with safe margins. Outline equivalent to 10-13px at 256px. No text, numbers, labels, runic writing, watermark, background, tile, vignette, ground, cast shadow, glow haze, loose sparkles, decorative clutter, or tiny details. No character or body wearing it. Show an isolated item. Color and shape must communicate the item, with at most one large distinctive emblem. Background and any holes are fully transparent; the object itself is opaque. Render as flat illustrated game art, not photorealistic or 3D.
